task_summary: Build swappable Wasserstein/discriminator adversary as an upstreamable scvi-tools TrainingPlan

steps.title: Read AdversarialTrainingPlan internals fully
steps.description: Read the full training_step (both optimizer branches), configure_optimizers, and how kl_weight/kappa gate the adversary, so the subclass reuses scvi's manual-optimization structure exactly. Confirm the module's z is exposed in inference_outputs.

steps.title: Port the adversary heads onto scvi z
steps.description: Adapt the harness's discriminator and Wasserstein-critic (reference, barycenter) heads to operate on scvi-tools' z tensor and batch_index, including the gradient penalty. Package as a swappable adversary selected by a string arg.

steps.title: Write WassersteinAdversarialTrainingPlan
steps.description: Subclass AdversarialTrainingPlan: replace the Classifier with the swappable adversary, implement the critic inner-loop (disc_iter) and the generator fool-loss term as loss_vae - lambda*loss_da, gated so adversary=none degrades to stock training. Expose lambda (d_coef) and formulation as plan_kwargs.

steps.title: Seeded lambda=0 bit-identity gate
steps.description: Train stock LinearSCVI and the new plan with adversary=none at the same seed; assert the latents are bit-identical (max|delta|=0). This is the upstreamability guarantee and replaces the statistical reproduction gate.

steps.title: Unconditioned LinearSCVI variant
steps.description: Determine how to remove the decoder batch covariate in scvi-tools (setup without batch_key, or a decoder flag) to get the unconditioned backbone where the adversary is the sole integrator; verify it trains and the adversary attaches.

steps.title: Run the immune adversarial sweep
steps.description: conditioned + unconditioned x reference/barycenter/discriminator x lambda{0, transition-point}, single seed, in scvi-env; score every embedding through the same full_metric_suite for comparability.

steps.title: Assemble results + upstreamable README
steps.description: Table the arms x conditioning x lambda results with the lambda=0 controls; write a README documenting the plan as a drop-in scvi-tools extension and how to use it.

desired_outputs: scvi_adversarial_plan.py — WassersteinAdversarialTrainingPlan subclassing scvi-tools AdversarialTrainingPlan, with swappable adversary (none/discriminator/reference-critic/barycenter-critic) on z
A seeded bit-identity test: at lambda=0 (adversary off), the plan reproduces stock LinearSCVI latents bit-for-bit (max|delta|=0)
immune adversarial-weight results: conditioned + unconditioned x reference/barycenter/discriminator x lambda{0, transition}, scored through the same metric suite
A short README documenting the plan as an upstreamable scvi-tools extension

feasibility.rationale: scvi-tools ships AdversarialTrainingPlan with exactly the two-optimizer VAE-plus-adversary structure needed, degrading to stock training when the adversary is off — so seeded lambda=0 bit-identity is achievable and the extension is genuinely upstreamable. The main uncertainty is porting the Wasserstein-critic formulations (reference/barycenter, with gradient penalty) onto scvi-tools' z and manual-optimization step, and whether 'unconditioned' requires a LinearSCVI variant with the decoder batch-covariate removed.
